sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D RPG character animation sprite sheet for Soul of Meal. Input image 1 is the identity canon reference, not the sheet layout. Subject: Small cheerful anthropomorphic golden pangolin, overlapping shiny golden rice-grain scales on head and back, cream muzzle and belly, huge warm brown eyes, thick segmented curling gold tail, yellow neckerchief, small dark brown claws. Carries a round engraved copper bowl of white sticky rice with both hands. Keep the pangolin snout, scales and bowl exactly recognizable. Primary request: paint exactly 16 clearly distinct FULL BODY poses of this SAME character in a strict evenly spaced 4 columns x 4 rows square sprite sheet. Row1 four subtle idle breathing/readiness poses; row2 four consecutive walking strides facing RIGHT; row3 four distinct melee attack stages windup, extension toward right, contact, recovery using their existing bowl/wand/staff/hoe; row4 four distinct support casting gestures prepare, gather, reach right, recover. Style: finely hand painted charming chibi fantasy, clean dark contour, softly shaded tactile material, consistent original identity and colors, readable at 64px. Same body proportions, equipment, camera and scale in all 16 cells. Three-quarter view facing RIGHT in every cell. Entire ears, hat, tail, basket, weapon, hands and feet inside each cell with large transparent margins. Exactly one unconnected character per cell. Keep gestures dynamic, authored limb positions, no simple duplicate or shifted clones. Transparent background, alpha outside character. No text, grid, number, border, watermark, ground, drop shadow, particles, magic effects, glow, extra characters or scenery.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D RPG sprite support sheet. Input image1 is the approved character sheet and material/style reference; image2 is the original identity canon. Subject: Small cheerful anthropomorphic golden pangolin, overlapping shiny golden rice-grain scales on head and back, cream muzzle and belly, huge warm brown eyes, thick segmented curling gold tail, yellow neckerchief, small dark brown claws. Carries a round engraved copper bowl of white sticky rice with both hands. Keep the pangolin snout, scales and bowl exactly recognizable. Paint exactly 16 FULL BODY distinct poses of this SAME actor in a strict evenly spaced 4 columns x 4 rows SQUARE transparent sheet. Row1 four powerful ultimate gestures: prepare low, lift signature bowl/wand/staff/hoe, fully extend RIGHT at impact, heroic follow-through. Row2 four hit recoil poses: flinch, lean back, brace, regain balance. Row3 four sequential non-graphic fainting/fall poses: kneel, lower body, lie fully on right side unconscious, resting sideways with equipment beside body; still the same complete character. Row4 four happy victory poses: rise proud, lift equipment, celebrate, relaxed smile. Same chibi hand-painted style, body scale, camera, identity, colors and equipment as input1. Clear authored anatomy and distinct limb positions, not moved copies. Character faces RIGHT, three-quarter view. Exactly one disconnected actor per cell with LARGE transparent gutters; keep whole tall ears/hat/basket/weapon/tail/feet inside each cell. Real transparent alpha, no ground, shadows, magic, particles, glow, text, numbering, watermark or extra people.
